versos.hebraico: ה֥וֹי הַחֹֽקְקִ֖ים חִקְקֵי־אָ֑וֶן וּֽמְכַתְּבִ֥ים עָמָ֖ל כִּתֵּֽבוּ׃

controles.web: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees;
controles.kjv: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;
controles.livre: Ai dos que decretam ordenanças injustas, e dos que escribas que escrevem coisas opressivas,

versos.hebraico: לְהַטּ֤וֹת מִדִּין֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְלִגְזֹ֕ל מִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיֵּ֣י עַמִּ֑י לִהְי֤וֹת אַלְמָנוֹת֙ שְׁלָלָ֔ם וְאֶת־יְתוֹמִ֖ים יָבֹֽזּוּ׃

controles.web: to deprive the needy from justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!
controles.kjv: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!
controles.livre: Para afastarem aos pobres de seu direito, e para tomarem o direito dos pobres de meu povo; para despojarem as viúvas, e para roubarem aos órfãos.

versos.hebraico: וּמַֽה־תַּעֲשׂוּ֙ לְי֣וֹם פְּקֻדָּ֔ה וּלְשׁוֹאָ֖ה מִמֶּרְחָ֣ק תָּב֑וֹא עַל־מִי֙ תָּנ֣וּסוּ לְעֶזְרָ֔ה וְאָ֥נָה תַעַזְב֖וּ כְּבוֹדְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?
controles.kjv: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?
controles.livre: Mas que fareis no dia da visitação e da assolação, que virá de longe? A quem recorrereis por socorro? E onde deixareis vossa glória?

versos.hebraico: בִּלְתִּ֤י כָרַע֙ תַּ֣חַת אַסִּ֔יר וְתַ֥חַת הֲרוּגִ֖ים יִפֹּ֑לוּ בְּכָל־זֹאת֙ לֹא־שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔וֹ וְע֖וֹד יָד֥וֹ נְטוּיָֽה׃ס

controles.web: They will only bow down under the prisoners,  and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
controles.kjv: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
controles.livre: Nada podem fazer ,a não ser se abaterem entre os presos, e caírem entre os mortos. Com tudo isto, sua ira não cessará, e sua mão ainda está estendida.

versos.hebraico: ה֥וֹי אַשּׁ֖וּר שֵׁ֣בֶט אַפִּ֑י וּמַטֶּה־ה֥וּא בְיָדָ֖ם זַעְמִֽי׃

controles.web: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
controles.kjv: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.
controles.livre: Ai da Assíria, a vara de minha ira; porque minha indignação é pão em suas mãos.

versos.hebraico: בְּג֤וֹי חָנֵף֙ אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔נּוּ וְעַל־עַ֥ם עֶבְרָתִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑נּוּ לִשְׁלֹ֤ל שָׁלָל֙ וְלָבֹ֣ז בַּ֔ז ולשימו מִרְמָ֖ס כְּחֹ֥מֶר חוּצֽוֹת׃

controles.web: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me will I give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
controles.kjv: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
controles.livre: Eu a enviarei contra um povo corrompido, e lhe darei ordem contra um povo do qual me enfureço; para que roube ao roubo, e despoje ao despojo, e para que o pisem como a lama das ruas;

versos.hebraico: וְהוּא֙ לֹא־כֵ֣ן יְדַמֶּ֔ה וּלְבָב֖וֹ לֹא־כֵ֣ן יַחְשֹׁ֑ב כִּ֚י לְהַשְׁמִ֣יד בִּלְבָב֔וֹ וּלְהַכְרִ֥ית גּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א מְעָֽט׃

controles.web: However he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.
controles.kjv: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
controles.livre: Ainda que ela não pense assim, nem pretenda isso seu coração; em vez disso, deseja em seu coração destruir e eliminar não poucas nações.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֖י יֹאמַ֑ר הֲלֹ֥א שָׂרַ֛י יַחְדָּ֖ו מְלָכִֽים׃

controles.web: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?
controles.kjv: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?
controles.livre: Pois diz: Por acaso os meus generais, não são todos eles reis?

versos.hebraico: הֲלֹ֥א כְּכַרְכְּמִ֖ישׁ כַּלְנ֑וֹ אִם־לֹ֤א כְאַרְפַּד֙ חֲמָ֔ת אִם־לֹ֥א כְדַמֶּ֖שֶׂק שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”
controles.kjv: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
controles.livre: Não é Calno como Carquemis? Não é Hamate como Arpade? Não é Samaria como Damasco?

versos.hebraico: כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ מָצְאָ֣ה יָדִ֔י לְמַמְלְכֹ֖ת הָאֱלִ֑יל וּפְסִ֣ילֵיהֶ֔ם מִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּמִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃

controles.web: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
controles.kjv: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
controles.livre: Assim como minha mão tomou aos reinos dos ídolos, cujas imagens eram melhores que Jerusalém e as de Samaria,

versos.hebraico: הֲלֹ֗א כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֛יתִי לְשֹׁמְר֖וֹן וְלֶאֱלִילֶ֑יהָ כֵּ֛ן אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה לִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְלַעֲצַבֶּֽיהָ׃ס

controles.web: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
controles.kjv: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
controles.livre: Por acaso não farei eu a Jerusalém e a seus ídolos da mesma maneira que fiz a Samaria e a seus ídolos?

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־יְבַצַּ֤ע אֲדֹנָי֙ אֶת־כָּל־מַֽעֲשֵׂ֔הוּ בְּהַ֥ר צִיּ֖וֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֶפְקֹ֗ד עַל־פְּרִי־גֹ֨דֶל֙ לְבַ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ־אַשּׁ֔וּר וְעַל־תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת ר֥וּם עֵינָֽיו׃

controles.web: Therefore it will happen that, when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his haughty looks.
controles.kjv: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
controles.livre: Porque acontecerá que, quando o Senhor tiver acabado toda sua obra no monte de Sião em Jerusalém, então: Visitarei para castigar o fruto da arrogância da rei da Assíria e a pompa do orgulho de seus olhos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י אָמַ֗ר בְּכֹ֤חַ יָדִי֙ עָשִׂ֔יתִי וּבְחָכְמָתִ֖י כִּ֣י נְבֻנ֑וֹתִי וְאָסִ֣יר׀ גְּבוּלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֗ים ועתידתיהם שׁוֹשֵׂ֔תִי וְאוֹרִ֥יד כַּאבִּ֖יר יוֹשְׁבִֽים׃

controles.web: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I have understanding: and I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.
controles.kjv: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:
controles.livre: Pois ele diz: Fiz isso com a força de minha mão e com minha sabedoria, pois sou esperto; e tirei as fronteiras dos povos, e roubei seus bens, e como guerreiro abati aos moradores.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּמְצָ֨א כַקֵּ֤ן׀ יָדִי֙ לְחֵ֣יל הָֽעַמִּ֔ים וְכֶאֱסֹף֙ בֵּיצִ֣ים עֲזֻב֔וֹת כָּל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲנִ֣י אָסָ֑פְתִּי וְלֹ֤א הָיָה֙ נֹדֵ֣ד כָּנָ֔ף וּפֹצֶ֥ה פֶ֖ה וּמְצַפְצֵֽף׃

controles.web: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, have I gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”
controles.kjv: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.
controles.livre: E minha mão tomou as riquezas dos povos como a um ninho; e como se juntam ovos abandonados, assim eu juntei toda a terra; e não houve quem movesse asa, ou abrisse boca, ou fizesse ruído.

versos.hebraico: הֲיִתְפָּאֵר֙ הַגַּרְזֶ֔ן עַ֖ל הַחֹצֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ אִם־יִתְגַּדֵּ֤ל הַמַּשּׂוֹר֙ עַל־מְנִיפ֔וֹ כְּהָנִ֥יף שֵׁ֨בֶט֙ וְאֶת־מְרִימָ֔יו כְּהָרִ֥ים מַטֶּ֖ה לֹא־עֵֽץ׃

controles.web: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.
controles.kjv: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
controles.livre: Por acaso o machado se glorificará contra aquele que com ele corta? Ou a serra se engrandecerá contra aquele que a manuseia? Seria como se fosse o bastão que movesse aos que o levantam, como se a vara fosse capaz de levantar, como se ela não fosse apenas madeira.

versos.hebraico: לָ֠כֵן יְשַׁלַּ֨ח הָאָד֜וֹן יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת בְּמִשְׁמַנָּ֖יו רָז֑וֹן וְתַ֧חַת כְּבֹד֛וֹ יֵקַ֥ד יְקֹ֖ד כִּיק֥וֹד אֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
controles.kjv: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
controles.livre: Por isso o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos enviará magreza entre seus gordos; e em lugar de sua glória ele inflamará um incêndio, como um incêndio de fogo.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֤ה אֽוֹר־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְאֵ֔שׁ וּקְדוֹשׁ֖וֹ לְלֶהָבָ֑ה וּבָעֲרָ֗ה וְאָֽכְלָ֛ה שִׁית֥וֹ וּשְׁמִיר֖וֹ בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
controles.kjv: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;
controles.livre: E a Luz de Israel virá a ser fogo, e seu Santo, labareda, que queima e consome seus espinhos e seus cardos em um dia.

versos.hebraico: וּכְב֤וֹד יַעְרוֹ֙ וְכַרְמִלּ֔וֹ מִנֶּ֥פֶשׁ וְעַד־בָּשָׂ֖ר יְכַלֶּ֑ה וְהָיָ֖ה כִּמְסֹ֥ס נֹסֵֽס׃

controles.web: He will consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.
controles.kjv: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.
controles.livre: Também consumirá a glória de sua floresta, e de seu campo fértil, desde a alma até a carne; e será como quando um doente se definha.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁאָ֥ר עֵ֛ץ יַעְר֖וֹ מִסְפָּ֣ר יִֽהְי֑וּ וְנַ֖עַר יִכְתְּבֵֽם׃פ

controles.web: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.
controles.kjv: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.
controles.livre: E o resto das árvores de sua floresta será tão pouco em número, que um menino será capaz de contá-las.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא לֹֽא־יוֹסִ֨יף ע֜וֹד שְׁאָ֤ר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּפְלֵיטַ֣ת בֵּֽית־יַעֲקֹ֔ב לְהִשָּׁעֵ֖ן עַל־מַכֵּ֑הוּ וְנִשְׁעַ֗ן עַל־יְהוָ֛ה קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּאֱמֶֽת׃

controles.web: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
controles.livre: E acontecerá naquele dia, que os restantes de Israel e os que escaparam da casa de Jacó nunca mais confiarão naquele que os feriu; ao invés disso, confiarão verdadeiramente no SENHOR, o Santo de Israel.

versos.hebraico: שְׁאָ֥ר יָשׁ֖וּב שְׁאָ֣ר יַעֲקֹ֑ב אֶל־אֵ֖ל גִּבּֽוֹר׃

controles.web: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
controles.kjv: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
controles.livre: Os restantes se converterão, os restantes de Jacó, ao Deus Forte.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י אִם־יִהְיֶ֞ה עַמְּךָ֤ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם שְׁאָ֖ר יָשׁ֣וּב בּ֑וֹ כִּלָּי֥וֹן חָר֖וּץ שׁוֹטֵ֥ף צְדָקָֽה׃

controles.web: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.
controles.kjv: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
controles.livre: Porque ainda que teu povo, ó Israel, seja como a areia do mar, apenas o restante dele se converterá; a destruição já está decretada, transbordante em justiça.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֥י כָלָ֖ה וְנֶחֱרָצָ֑ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת עֹשֶׂ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס

controles.web: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, in the midst of all the earth.
controles.kjv: For the Lord God of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
controles.livre: Pois a destruição que foi decretada, o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos a executará no meio de toda a terra.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת אַל־תִּירָ֥א עַמִּ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב צִיּ֖וֹן מֵֽאַשּׁ֑וּר בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט יַכֶּ֔כָּה וּמַטֵּ֥הוּ יִשָּֽׂא־עָלֶ֖יךָ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, says “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.
controles.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
controles.livre: Por isso assim diz o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos: Não temas, povo meu, que habita em Sião, ao assírio, quando te ferir com vara, e contra ti levantar seu bastão da maneira dos egípcios.

versos.hebraico: כִּי־ע֖וֹד מְעַ֣ט מִזְעָ֑ר וְכָ֣לָה זַ֔עַם וְאַפִּ֖י עַל־תַּבְלִיתָֽם׃

controles.web: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”
controles.kjv: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.
controles.livre: Pois em breve se completará a indignação e a minha ira, para os consumir.

versos.hebraico: וְעוֹרֵ֨ר עָלָ֜יו יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שׁ֔וֹט כְּמַכַּ֥ת מִדְיָ֖ן בְּצ֣וּר עוֹרֵ֑ב וּמַטֵּ֨הוּ֙ עַל־הַיָּ֔ם וּנְשָׂא֖וֹ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Yahweh of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.
controles.kjv: And the Lord of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
controles.livre: Pois o SENHOR dos exércitos levantará um açoite contra ele, como a matança de Midiã junto à rocha de Orebe; e sua vara estará sobre o mar, a qual ele levantará da maneira que ele fez aos egípcios.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יָס֤וּר סֻבֳּלוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל שִׁכְמֶ֔ךָ וְעֻלּ֖וֹ מֵעַ֣ל צַוָּארֶ֑ךָ וְחֻבַּ֥ל עֹ֖ל מִפְּנֵי־שָֽׁמֶן׃

controles.web: It will happen in that day, that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
controles.livre: E acontecerá naquele dia, que sua carga será tirada de teu ombro, e seu jugo de teu pescoço; e o jugo será despedaçado por causa da unção.

versos.hebraico: בָּ֥א עַל־עַיַּ֖ת עָבַ֣ר בְּמִגְר֑וֹן לְמִכְמָ֖שׂ יַפְקִ֥יד כֵּלָֽיו׃

controles.web: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
controles.kjv: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
controles.livre: Eles, os assírios ,chegaram a Aiate, passaram por Migrom, em Micmás puseram seus instrumentos.

versos.hebraico: עָֽבְרוּ֙ מַעְבָּרָ֔ה גֶּ֖בַע מָל֣וֹן לָ֑נוּ חָֽרְדָה֙ הָֽרָמָ֔ה גִּבְעַ֥ת שָׁא֖וּל נָֽסָה׃

controles.web: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.
controles.kjv: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
controles.livre: Passaram o vau, se abrigaram em Geba. Ramá está tremendo, Gibeá de Saul está fugindo.

versos.hebraico: צַהֲלִ֥י קוֹלֵ֖ךְ בַּת־גַּלִּ֑ים הַקְשִׁ֥יבִי לַ֖יְשָׁה עֲנִיָּ֥ה עֲנָתֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!
controles.kjv: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
controles.livre: Grita com tua voz, ó filha de Galim! Ouve, Laís! Pobre de ti, Anatote!

versos.hebraico: נָדְדָ֖ה מַדְמֵנָ֑ה יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הַגֵּבִ֖ים הֵעִֽיזוּ׃

controles.web: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
controles.kjv: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
controles.livre: Madmena foge; os moradores de Gebim procuram refúgios.

versos.hebraico: ע֥וֹד הַיּ֖וֹם בְּנֹ֣ב לַֽעֲמֹ֑ד יְנֹפֵ֤ף יָדוֹ֙ הַ֣ר בית־צִיּ֔וֹן גִּבְעַ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

controles.web: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Ainda hoje parará em Nobe; moverá sua mão contra o monte da Filha de Sião, o morro de Jerusalém.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֤ה הָאָדוֹן֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת מְסָעֵ֥ף פֻּארָ֖ה בְּמַעֲרָצָ֑ה וְרָמֵ֤י הַקּוֹמָה֙ גְּדוּעִ֔ים וְהַגְּבֹהִ֖ים יִשְׁפָּֽלוּ׃

controles.web: Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.
controles.kjv: Behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
controles.livre: Eis que o Senhor DEUS dos exércitos cortará os galhos com violência; e os de alta estatura serão cortados, e os elevados serão abatidos.

versos.hebraico: וְנִקַּ֛ף סִֽבְכֵ֥י הַיַּ֖עַר בַּבַּרְזֶ֑ל וְהַלְּבָנ֖וֹן בְּאַדִּ֥יר יִפּֽוֹל׃ס

controles.web: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
controles.kjv: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
controles.livre: E cortará os emaranhados da floresta com machado de ferro; e o Líbano cairá pelo Grandioso.
